limitations: This is a MALDI-TIMS mass spectrometry imaging (lipid, negative mode) dataset, not bottom-up proteomics; the ms-proteomics template is declared only to satisfy the repository's validation, so technology type reads 'proteomic profiling by mass spectrometry' and cleavage/label/fraction/dissociation values are placeholders (not applicable / label free sample / 1) as no real values exist.

The deposit is a single 14 GB zip (verified by reading its zip64 central directory by HTTP range); it contains exactly one acquisition, Slide2_lipid_neg_TIMS_on_3.d, plus method backups, a .tif optical image, .mis, info/msg/poslog files. The archive filename is claimed as data file, the .d run name as assay name.

Four hemispheres were measured together on one slide in one run; per-animal data cannot be separated, so there is one row with biological replicate 1 as a placeholder and genotype recorded as mixed. Positions of the hemispheres on the slide are not mapped in the deposit.

Sex and disease are not available; developmental stage is not available (only an age of 100 days is stated, not an EFO stage). The non-APPtg animals' genotype is not stated and is not assumed to be wild type.
The deposited annotation_file_mock.txt only states that no lipid annotation was done; the dataset is for developing a data processing pipeline (MSI-visual).

The ms1 scan range, mobility range and acquisition date come from the protocol text and the deposited FlexImaging info file; acquisition ran overnight 2024-02-14 to 2024-02-15 and only the start date is recorded.
C57BL/6J gives a validator warning because strain or breed is free text; the linked preprint (DOI 10.1101/2025.03.09.642213) was not read, and no claim cites it.

SANDBOX ONLY (independent review FAIL): this is MALDI-TIMS lipid imaging, not bottom-up proteomics; ms-proteomics was declared with placeholder values for required columns (technology type, cleavage, label, fraction, dissociation) that have no true source value, and biological replicate 1 is a placeholder for four pooled animals on one slide. Age should be written 100D.
